verdict.rationale: Gating who can drive a self-hosted assistant is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no messaging-channel integrations and no sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating for inbound messages. The 'Access Control' and 'Authentication System' pages appear only as titles and describe app-level login and permissions, which is an adjacent control, not inbound message gating. The '@' mention only selects which agent to use; it does not gate who can talk to the assistant.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
